topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The silence of my home was punctuated by the soft thud of the delivery person leaving something at my door. When I cautiously opened the front door, there they were: a vase filled with wildly beautiful flowers, a vivid splash of color against the stark background of my entryway. No card, no note, just these blooms staring at me with their wordless mouths. I stood there, the weight of their presence sinking in, wondering who would send such a thing without a word of explanation. My heart fluttered against my ribs, and I found myself stepping back, the door closing softly as if to shield me from whatever enigma these flowers represented. I’ve been sitting here, looking at them, feeling the walls of my home close in, the petals a mystery I’m not sure I want to untangle.
